>
[Versatile Blasts](/Feats.aspx?ID=4185) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 21

</column>

---

Accessing a wider realm of elemental manifestations, you can make blasts with rare forms of your elements. Add the following damage types to those you can choose for [Elemental Blasts](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) of that element: **air** cold, **earth** poison, **fire** cold, **metal** electricity, **water** acid, **wood** poison.
